exact_comparison: uniform distribution over all N observed omission teams at k=N-1; used only when all N distinct teams present
quality_missing: not zero; conditional distribution plus quality availability fraction (not claimed as pure complete-output rate)
P10: Both linear and inverse empirical CDF saved explicitly. Existing finite exact convention is inverse CDF. Linear-to-linear comparison is an estimator sensitivity only, not a replacement for adopted exact P10.
SD: population SD for the exact finite distribution, separate from sample SD in the main 256-path table
